answers.description: Reference-free Gemma 4 (google/gemma-4-31B-it) with reasoning enabled. The null task2_pred scores are imputed using the mean score of the same MT system across all non-null segments in the same language pair, falling back to that system's global mean across all pairs, and finally to the dataset-wide mean if no non-null scores exist for that system.
answers.name: Gemma 4 - Reasoning Baseline
